title: Exploring Persona-dependent LLM Alignment for the Moral Machine Experiment

live_model.evidence: Sec. Models: "GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-05-13 (Hurst et al., 2024))"; alignment results table, e.g. "GPT-4o: 7/14" categories showing closer human alignment than baseline (bold cells).

prompt.location: Appendix A.1 (scenario/persona prompt templates), A.2 (survey data)
prompt.note: Persona template adapted from Gupta et al. (2024).

claim.metric: count of demographic categories with improved human alignment vs. baseline (bold cells)

data.source: Moral Machine experiment scenarios/data (Awad et al., 2018)

notes: The headline metric (AMCE Euclidean distance) requires a statistical-modeling pipeline over many raw trials, not a single API-call-to-score mapping; the exact total number of underlying moral-dilemma trials is not restated as one figure in the visible text, only 9 AMCE scenario categories crossed with persona/demographic combinations. ICLR 2025 peer-reviewed paper.
